findings.title: Avoid interpolating already-interpolated shard queries again
findings.body: The shard-splitting path now calls applyTemplateVariables in runShardSplitQuery and then delegates each shard batch to runSplitQuery, which calls it again here. Template interpolation is not idempotent when a variable value contains another variable reference. For example, if search has the literal value '$host', `{app="x"} |= "$search"` is first expanded to a search for '$host', then expanded again to the value of host. This changes the user's query and can return incorrect results. Pass already-interpolated shard targets through without another template expansion, and add a regression test covering dollar-containing variable values.
